app.title: Dark Dimensions
app.subtitle: Where every road remembers your failures
app.desktopOnlyText: Dark Dimensions is designed for mouse and keyboard. Open it on a desktop or laptop to continue your campaign.

startMenu.warning: This permanently abandons the current run, erases its autosave, and starts a new world.
startMenu.saveFound: An Ironman autosave is ready to continue.
startMenu.noSave: No saved campaign found. Begin a new journey.

hud.saveBlocked: Progress is saved automatically in Ironman mode.
hud.controls: WASD move · Arrow keys pan camera · Space recenters
hud.healed: The city healers restored your surviving monsters.
hud.healBlocked: No wounded monsters, or not enough gold.
hud.hostiles: Red warbands hunt you. Contact begins battle.

warbandTooltip.click: Click to travel to this warband

warbandInteraction.talkResult: {{name}} greets you briefly and keeps one eye on the road.
warbandInteraction.infoResult: {{name}} reports movement near hostile camps and trade roads.

map.title: Strategic Map
map.subtitle: Explore the realm, read its roads, and mark your next destination.
map.hint: Select a discovered location for details, or tap the map to place a waypoint.

plains.name: Plains
plains.battle: Open ground offers no major advantage.

forest.name: Forest
forest.battle: Dense cover raises DEF and lowers ATK.

darkForest.name: Darkwood
darkForest.battle: Ancient cover favors ambushes and defensive beasts.

pineForest.name: Pinewood
pineForest.battle: Tall pines offer light cover and narrow sightlines.

tundra.name: Tundra
tundra.battle: Frozen open ground slows armies and exposes formations.

snowMountain.name: Frostpeaks
snowMountain.battle: Icy heights punish movement and favor hardy defenders.

swamp.name: Swamp
swamp.battle: Deep mud reduces ATK and DEF.

desert.name: Desert
desert.battle: Open heat raises ATK but weakens DEF.

grassland.name: Grassland
grassland.battle: Open fields offer clear movement and fair footing.

mountain.name: Mountains
mountain.battle: The mountain paths are too steep for battle.

hills.name: Hills
hills.battle: Rolling ground slows armies but favors scouts.

river.name: River
river.battle: Unstable footing sharply lowers ATK and DEF.

road.name: Road
road.battle: Ordered formations gain ATK but lose some cover.

city.marketDescription: Buy supplies, sell cargo, and use local workshops.
city.recruitDescription: Hire weak human troops and organize the Warband.
city.characterDescription: Spend attribute and skill points to shape the Wanderer.
city.contractDescription: Accept local work and claim completed faction rewards.
city.saveDescription: Record the journey at this protected settlement.

warband.title: Warband & Prisoners
warband.subtitle: Warband Ledger
warband.selectUnit: Select a creature to inspect its stats and upgrade branches.
warband.recruitmentLocked: Recruitment is only available inside a city.
warband.emptyActive: No hired units. Your hero will fight alone.
warband.notInCity: This action is only available in a city.
warband.heroNote: Your hero leads from behind the formation and never occupies a unit slot.

character.title: Character
character.subtitle: Grow the Wanderer through attributes and Mount-and-Blade-style skills.

strength.name: Strength
strength.effect: +80 hero HP and minor hero damage

woundTreatment.name: Wound Treatment
woundTreatment.description: Slowly heals surviving units while time passes.

trainer.name: Trainer
trainer.description: Deployed survivors gain extra battle XP.

persuasion.name: Persuasion
persuasion.description: Later improves quests, recruitment, and diplomacy.

battle.title: Card Battle
battle.commandEnemyTargetPrompt: Strategic Attack: choose an enemy unit. The leader is targetable only when the field is empty.
battle.commandAllyTargetPrompt: Choose a wounded allied unit or the leader.

raceIdentity.hero: A leader whose commands shape the formation and decide when to strike.
raceIdentity.human: Disciplined troops focused on defense, healing, and protecting allies.
raceIdentity.orc: Aggressive warriors who grow more dangerous through rage and overwhelming force.
raceIdentity.kobold: Numerous tricksters who become stronger in packs and disrupt enemy plans.
raceIdentity.undead: Relentless dead who drain life, exploit casualties, and return from defeat.
raceIdentity.machine: Armored constructs built around shields, repair, and resistance.
raceIdentity.elemental: Unstable beings that spread direct damage and battlefield conditions.
raceIdentity.beast: Fast hunters that focus wounded prey and gain strength from the pack.

effects.heal_lowest_300: On summon: heal the most wounded ally by 300 HP.
effects.burn_weakest_300: On summon: deal 300 damage to the weakest enemy.
effects.rally_all_150: On summon: all allies gain 150 ATK this round.
effects.human_guard_all_180: On summon: all allies gain 180 DEF this round.
effects.orc_rage_self_250: On summon: this unit gains 250 ATK this round.
effects.kobold_pack_100: On summon: gain 100 ATK for every allied Kobold.
effects.undead_drain_200: On summon: drain up to 200 HP from the weakest enemy.
effects.beast_pack_120: On summon: allied Beasts gain 120 ATK this round.
effects.human_first_aid_180: On summon: heal the most wounded ally by 180 HP.
effects.human_brace_160: On summon: all allies gain 160 DEF this round.
effects.human_volley_120: On summon: deal 120 damage to the weakest enemy.
effects.orc_bloodrage_180: On summon: this unit gains 180 ATK this round.
effects.orc_overrun_160: On summon: deal 160 damage to the weakest enemy.
effects.kobold_trap_140: On summon: the strongest enemy loses 140 ATK this round.
effects.undead_reanimate_30: On summon: gain a shield equal to 30% of maximum HP.
effects.machine_repair_180: On summon: repair the most damaged ally by 180 HP.
effects.machine_armor_all_140: On summon: all allies gain 140 DEF this round.
effects.elemental_frost_140: On summon: the strongest enemy loses 140 ATK this round.
effects.elemental_chain_160: On summon: deal 160 damage to every enemy unit.
effects.beast_first_strike_140: On summon: deal 140 damage to the weakest enemy.
effects.beast_hunt_160: On summon: gain 160 ATK if an enemy is wounded.

battle.victoryText: The enemy warband breaks and scatters.
battle.defeatText: Death is final. This Ironman run and its autosave will be erased.
battle.afterReportHint: Review losses and performance, then choose the spoils you actually want to carry.
battle.unitsInstruction: Recruit captured enemies if there is room, upgrade veterans, or dismiss units before carrying loot.
battle.releasedUnitHint: Will leave permanently when you continue to loot.
battle.lootInstruction: Move items from the loot pile into your inventory. Gold is collected automatically.
battle.capturedUnitHint: Can be taken prisoner after battle.
battle.capturedPrisonerHint: Goes to your prisoners. Recruit later with gold, XP, and morale.
battle.noRosterSpace: No roster space. Dismiss a unit first.
battle.instructions: Summon units, arrange your warband, then resolve the automatic battle round.

locationActions.dangerResult: The expedition turns hostile. Your Warband loses {{amount}}% HP.
locationActions.alreadyVisited: There is nothing more to gain here.

trade.caravanDescription: Long-distance merchants carrying processed goods between cities.
trade.villagerDescription: A local trader carrying village produce toward the nearest city.
trade.marketHint: Travel to a village or city to buy and sell goods.
trade.processed: Raw materials processed into trade goods.
trade.used: The most wounded surviving unit was treated.
trade.invalid: That action is not available here.
trade.merchantCannotAfford: The merchant cannot afford that quantity.
trade.selectPrompt: Select an item from either side to prepare a trade.

quests.title: Quest Ledger
quests.noLocalQuests: No new contract is posted here.
quests.claimed: Reward claimed and faction reputation increased.
quests.unavailable: This contract is no longer available.
quests.notReady: The contract conditions are not yet fulfilled at this location.
quests.escortDescription: Remain near the assigned caravan until it reaches {{target}}.

dialog.delivery: Our stores are running thin. Bring {{quantity}} crates of {{item}} back to this city and I will see that you are paid before the council bell fades.
dialog.bounty: {{enemy}} packs have been bleeding the roads. Hunt down {{count}} of their warbands, then return here for your reward.
dialog.escort: A caravan leaves from our gate and must reach {{target}} intact. Stay close enough that raiders think twice.

rustySword.description: Right hand weapon: cheap iron, better than a club if it holds together.

militiaSpear.description: Right hand weapon: simple reach and reliable piercing damage.

huntingBow.name: Hunting Bow
huntingBow.description: Right hand weapon: a light bow adapted from village hunters.

ironMace.name: Iron Mace
ironMace.description: Right hand weapon: heavy blunt force favored against armor.

steelSword.name: Steel Sword
steelSword.description: Right hand weapon: a proper battlefield blade with strong damage.

warAxe.description: Right hand weapon: brutal chopping power, heavy but decisive.

knightlyLongsword.description: Right hand weapon: expensive noble steel with excellent damage.

simpleShield.name: Simple Shield

description.city: A fortified refuge of trade, soldiers, and crowded streets. Progress is recorded automatically at its gates.
description.village: A small settlement clinging to life beyond the protection of high walls.
description.castle: A grim stronghold guarding old roads and older grudges.
description.dungeon: A hostile depth promising rare enemies, cards, and an early grave.
description.landmark: An ancient place whose purpose has been lost to time.
description.wilds: Untamed country where wandering warbands gather.

hollowmere.name: Hollowmere
hollowmere.description: A walled refuge built around a well that never reflects the moon.

gloamwood.name: Gloamwood
gloamwood.description: The trees whisper in voices stolen from lost travelers.

sunkenVault.name: The Sunken Vault
sunkenVault.description: A drowned archive where iron sentinels still guard forbidden cards.

witchStone.name: Witch Stone
witchStone.description: An ancient marker stained by generations of desperate bargains.

cinderwatch.name: Cinderwatch
cinderwatch.description: A fortress-town watching the volcanic road to the east.

swordsman.name: Swordsman
swordsman.description: A disciplined attacker trained to break open exposed formations.

noble_recruit.name: Noble Recruit
noble_recruit.description: A privileged recruit with the training and means to join the cavalry.

mounted_squire.name: Mounted Squire
mounted_squire.description: A mobile retainer learning to lead a charge from horseback.

lancer.name: Lancer
lancer.description: A heavy cavalry attacker whose charge punishes weakened lines.

royal_cavalier.name: Royal Cavalier
royal_cavalier.description: An elite mounted champion and symbol of human command.

halberdier.name: Halberdier
halberdier.description: A veteran polearm fighter who controls the front line.

orc_youngblood.name: Orc Youngblood
orc_youngblood.description: An eager raider: dangerous, but still beatable by a new warband.

kobold_slinger.name: Kobold Slinger
kobold_slinger.description: A skirmisher who wins through distraction and dirty tricks.

scrap_automaton.name: Scrap Automaton
scrap_automaton.description: A slow machine assembled from mismatched armor plates.

maintenance_drone.name: Maintenance Drone
maintenance_drone.description: A fragile support construct built to repair allied machines.

ember_spark.name: Ember Spark
ember_spark.description: A small but volatile spark of living flame.

frost_spark.name: Frost Spark
frost_spark.description: A shard of cold that slows enemy aggression.

storm_spark.name: Storm Spark
storm_spark.description: Unstable lightning searching for a path through its enemies.

stray_wolf.name: Stray Wolf
stray_wolf.description: A lean predator that hunts wounded prey.

giant_rat.name: Giant Rat
giant_rat.description: A vicious scavenger made bold by the pack.

cave_bat.name: Cave Bat
cave_bat.description: A swift cavern hunter that strikes before the line can settle.

lost_soul.name: Lost Soul
lost_soul.description: A fading spirit that steals warmth from the living.

plague_rat.name: Plague Rat
plague_rat.description: A diseased pack hunter hardened by carrion and ruin.

alpha_rat.name: Rat King
alpha_rat.description: An enormous alpha that drives its swarm into a frenzy.
